message.entry: Invalid input argument. Fcn must be a function handle or a symbolic expression.

A symbolic expression was given as Fcn, but Symbolic Math Toolbox is not available. Pass Fcn as a numeric function handle instead, and optionally Jac as a function handle that returns the Jacobian (without Jac, the Jacobian is computed by numerical differentiation).
The calculation was performed up to the maximum number of iterations, but it failed to converge.
